ns2:section.sectionText: Building an Audience: Fans, Haters, and Clout Seekers. Audiences are everywhere, we all belong in many different subsets of audiences. This class seeks to understand the importance of audience building at the start of a campaign and how to properly guide your brand to use an audience properly throughout the customer journey. Emphasis is placed on understanding the importance of data tools to build audiences and how to add these tools into the start of the research process.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Graduate, Junior, or Senior class standing.
